item.title: SUNshine Girl Laura
item.description: SUNshine Girl Laura is a 5-foot-8 Virgo who loves to explore new places with friends. Hobbies for the hazel-eyed beauty include art, photography and modelling. Laura, who posed for us in December 2017, says her dream job is to animate Disney movies. (Stan Behal/Toronto Sun)
